descriptionChirho: A proper noun meaning 'YHWH has ransomed,' borne by several individuals in the Hebrew Bible including a grandfather of King Josiah (2 Kgs 23:36), a son of Jeconiah (1 Chr 3:18), a wall-builder under Nehemiah (Neh 3:25), and others. The three clusters differ only in the conjunction prefix (and-Pedayah) and the longer theophoric form (Pedayahu). Spanish 'Pedaías/Pedaya,' Hindi 'पदायाह' (Padāyāh), Arabic 'فَدايا/فَدَايَاهُو' (Fadāyā/Fadāyāhū), Korean '페다야/비다야후' (Pedaya/Bidayahu), Swahili 'Pedaya' — all eight occurrences refer to this same name.
